text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am truly delighted to welcome such a 
glorious year... May the new days ahead 
also be filled with blessings.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Trainer-san. May we 
remain together on the journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The battle in the Classic year is 
finally about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: A huge wall... A truly massive wall.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A shadow may fall over our heads, as if to 
blot out everything.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I will not question your resolve at this 
late stage... However, please allow me to 
say just one thing."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships stand in our 
way... we will move forward together. You 
are by no means alone.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —There is nothing to fear.

The encouraging words she offered seemed 
meant to reassure herself as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've welcomed the new year, I 
would like to take this opportunity to 
reflect upon... the Saint once more.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You must also have acquired knowledge 
about the Saint from various books."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Even if we may not be identical... Won't 
you walk the path of the Saint alongside 
me?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —With your guidance.

Could this be some sort of test for 
whoever walks beside the saint?

It was sudden, but I wanted to live up to 
her expectations. ...Thinking back to the 
novels I've read, what the maidens called 
saints did was—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent, great tree...! I can 
feel a holy power from it. It must have 
witnessed so much history.

—The Saint's Pilgrimage. While it might 
not be identical to the story, we travel 
searching for places closely resembling 
it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"O mighty tree, O great tree. Tell me, how 
much pain and joy have you carved into 
your rings?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That was a passage from the novel 'The 
Great Saint Meets the Giant Tree,' wasn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The great tree revealing the hidden 
conspiracy within history to the saint... 
It was such a mystical, wonderful scene."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then, looking at this great tree... 
Trainer, what comes to your mind? What 
teachings do you gather from it?

A thick trunk too wide to wrap one's arms 
around. Leaves lush and green even in 
winter. A vitality that has survived the 
ages—
choice_data_list: ...Maybe the power to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes! I felt the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...In this world, there are many trials I 
must face and overcome."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, I will never 
stop... Even if I believe that, perhaps 
there might still be times when I feel 
like breaking.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"For that very reason, let us offer our 
prayers here and receive power from the 
Great Tree."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The strength to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A purifying stream... "O flow of the 
sacred river, wash away the defilement of 
this body."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is the novel, 'The Fake Saintess Was 
the Light That Cleansed the Defilement,' 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The girl suspected of being a fake takes 
the impurities into herself to save the 
people... and the spirit of the sacred 
river washes it all away.

The soothing sound of the river, the 
splashing water sparkling brightly. A 
space that makes you want to stay here 
forever—
choice_data_list:
A healing presence that saves people's 
hearts...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even when doubted as an imposter, she 
never lost sight of who she was as a 
saint...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That was pure conviction. Believing in 
herself as a saint, she fulfilled her 
duty.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...My greatest trial, the absolute 
heroine, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I may not be an impostor, but I cannot yet 
be called a true saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The path to that other world is paved with 
battles in the Classic year... and a 
massive wall in the form of Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To overcome those trials, half-baked 
resolve will not suffice. I must hold true 
to my conviction as a Saint."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us pray, and swear once more. That I 
shall never bend my convictions.

And so, I went on a pilgrimage along the 
"Path to Sainthood" together with Red 
Desire—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Your guidance was even more wonderful 
than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Listen to the voice of nature and offer a 
prayer. When I embark on a pilgrimage to 
an alternate world someday, I shall take 
today as an example.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It was truly a day that cleansed the soul.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...A test? What are you referring to?
choice_data_list:
To prove myself worthy of walking beside 
the saintess—

text_block_list.text:
When I tilted my head wondering if I was 
being tested, Red Desire tilted her head 
in the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I would never do something like testing 
you."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The moment we made our sacred contract, I 
placed my trust in you, and... Ah, but 
I've caused a misunderstanding, haven't I!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am sorry. This time, I just...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —I was a little anxious, to be honest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Neither the strength nor the conviction to 
keep walking forward will ever vanish from 
within me. ...However.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Faced with such a massive wall... Can I 
truly remain myself? Can I stand without 
crumbling?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, I am a Saintess. I 
am an existence that must support the 
people. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I just found myself wishing for a little 
emotional support.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Walking through the sanctuary, my body 
was enveloped in blessings."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is no exaggeration to say that she 
carried great expectations as the chosen 
saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can hold onto an even 
stronger feeling of resolve.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer. By guiding me and 
witnessing my pilgrimage, you have become 
my witness in this world... that I am 
indeed a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, don't ever forget this day.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Let us overcome our trials, 
gather even more radiance—and make this a 
year etched deeply into our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: This is a new promise with you... A vow.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, you're right! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, that's right! Trainer-san, out of 
all the sacred grounds we visited today... 
where do you think the blessing was 
strongest?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering how you felt about 
it...
choice_data_list:
Right here, right now—this is the best 
place to be.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That's the first place we visited, isn't 
it! Yes, I could intensely feel a 
magnificent power emanating from that 
splendid, great tree!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With that level of power... no matter how 
many years pass, it will never fade, and 
will surely continue to weave history for 
years to come.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...It might be nice to visit again before 
I depart for the other realm."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"So that the great feats we achieved in 
this world will always be remembered."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that soothing sound...! It felt so 
truly comforting.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The babbling brook sounds just like the 
song of a saint... I want to heal so many 
people with a singing voice like that 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, and to do that, I must win the race 
and stand upon the stage.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Adorned with manifold brilliance... like a 
true holy maiden.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...You chose this place, where we made 
our vows for the new year."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Every corner of the place was filled with 
celebration... Yes. I might feel the exact 
same way.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu! Well then, once again, shall we 
pray together here?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: May there be glory—on the path we walk!
